messages:
carol_p: Heads-up: final silent-window sweep starts in 10m. Post any last-minute exemptions or pins. I'll call go/no-go at T-2.
ajay_sre: Are canaries all green? @deploy-bot status?
deploy-bot: canary-1: healthy, canary-2: degraded (latency +120ms). Marked canary-2 for manual review.
maria_eng: I just rolled canary-2 back one commit. Latency dropped ~90ms, re-running smoke now.
sam_ops: DB migration lock scheduled at +1m (read-only). Setting lock-id: lock-93. Any objections?
jordan_releases: No objections from release side. Rollback playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollback-v2.md
carol_p: Decision incl. from PM: maintain silent window to 03:00 UTC, pin prod to v2.8.1. No additional schema changes during window.
alex_qa: Running quick regression on function-call formatting. If we see broken function signatures I'll file a hotfix immediately.
maria_eng: Hotfix flow reminder: patch branch -> deploy-bot pin -> canary -> smoke -> hand rollout. Keep changes minimal.
ajay_sre: I'm enabling the degraded-fallback policy (route to smaller variant) if p95 > 500ms or error spikes. Monitoring dashboards on.
deploy-bot: pin applied: v2.8.1 -> prod (pin_id: pin-3821).
carol_p: :thumbsup: Calling go at T-2. Keep this thread for live updates only.
sam_ops: Quick ops note: legal & CS notification queued. Liaison will confirm.
liaison-bot: Notification sent to legal@redwood and cs-ops channel.
alex_qa: Smoke ran: 3/3 checks passed, no function-call regression on system role cases.
jordan_releases: Final rollout triggers and rollback thresholds posted here: error rate >1.2% for 5m OR p95 latency >600ms for 3m -> immediate rollback to v2.8.0. Oncall: @ajay_sre will execute.
carol_p: Solid. Closing sweep and switching channel to read-only for launch window. :lock: If anything urgent, ping pager.
